overview.title: Tax, accounting and payroll for Texas families and growing businesses.
overview.text: Pick a service to see what it covers, or call and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Tax Preparation
services.text: Today's tax laws are increasingly complicated and the rules for deductions and credits change year by year. There is no substitute for an experienced tax professional who can answer your questions and ask you the ones that save you tax dollars.
services.lead: How confident are you that your return is accurate, and could you be missing potential deductions? Tax software does not ask you the questions that matter. We do.

covers.title: Checked for accuracy
covers.text: Assurance that your return has been checked and double-checked for mathematical accuracy and the errors that are commonly flagged by the IRS, resulting in fewer chances for contact by the IRS.

covers.title: Withholding advice
covers.text: Tips for better managing your payroll withholding so that you have the advantage of greater income all year long, rather than loaning that money to the government and waiting for it to come back as a refund.

covers.title: Deductions for next year
covers.text: A list of common deductions that may benefit you in the coming year, and tips for limiting your future tax liability.

covers.title: Electronic filing
covers.text: Electronic filing for a quicker refund.

questions.q: What paperwork do I need for small business taxes?
questions.a: Income records, expense receipts, payroll documents, prior year returns, and any 1099s or K-1s you received. A big mistake we see here is mixing personal and business expenses: keep them separate from day one and it will save you hours during tax prep.

questions.q: How do I get ready for my appointment?
questions.a: Getting organized before your tax appointment saves a lot of time and is well worth the effort. We publish a tax preparation checklist you can download and work through; not every item will apply to you, but it covers 95% of our clients.

services.title: Tax Planning
services.summary: Shrink next year's bill, not just file this one.
services.text: Our tax professionals focus on the nuances of tax law and stay up to date on the changes that affect your returns through the year, because planning is the key to valuable tax savings.
services.lead: Would you like to shrink your yearly tax burden? Our clients pay the least amount of taxes allowable by law, because we help them look for ways to minimize it all year rather than once at filing.

covers.title: Income timing
covers.text: Shift income and expenses to different years in order to best take advantage of lower rates, and move income into lower tax brackets by splitting it among family members or legal entities.

covers.title: Deferring liability
covers.text: Defer tax liability through some types of investment options, and avoid it through others, both at the federal and the state level.

covers.title: Deductions and retirement
covers.text: Increase your deductions, and plan for retirement in ways that benefit you rather than the IRS.

covers.title: Estate and giving
covers.text: Understand estate taxes and planning so that your family keeps more of what you make, and give money in ways that reduce taxes and maximize your giving potential.

questions.q: Do I pay the IRS when I file or throughout the year?
questions.a: If you expect to owe $1,000 or more and do not have enough withholding from other sources, you need to make quarterly estimated payments. Follow the Safe Harbor Rule: pay 100% of last year's tax liability, or 110% if your AGI exceeded $150K, to avoid penalties.

questions.q: Does the planning fee pay for itself?
questions.a: Our fees are often paid back through the reduced tax liability you enjoy as part of our planning and legitimate tax saving strategies.

services.title: IRS Representation
services.summary: Take on an audit without lifting a finger.
services.text: An IRS tax auditor is trained to pick apart a return and scrutinize every line. Our clients rarely have to do more than forward us the audit letter.
services.lead: There is nothing more time-consuming than a crash course in tax law when the IRS decides to audit your return. We take on the IRS for you.

covers.title: The letter comes to us
covers.text: Forward us an IRS Notification of Audit Letter and we take it from there.

covers.title: The paperwork
covers.text: We handle the paperwork, the questions, the scrutiny and the intimidation factor while you go on about your business as usual.

covers.title: A free consultation
covers.text: If you have received an audit letter, get in touch and one of our tax specialists will be in contact with a free consultation.

services.title: Tax Problem Resolution
services.summary: Liens, levies, garnishments and unfiled returns.
services.text: You've got a friend in the tax business. From IRS wage garnishment protection to helping you get innocent spouse protection, we have the experience you need.
services.lead: Let our team of experienced tax relief experts help you find the light at the end of the tunnel.

covers.title: Asset seizure protection
covers.text: When the IRS moves to confiscate your home, your car or even your retirement accounts.

covers.title: Levies, liens and garnishments
covers.text: Help getting money and assets back after a levy, safeguards for your credit against an IRS lien, and protection when the IRS reaches into your paycheck.

covers.title: Offers in compromise
covers.text: An offer in compromise could be the solution you need. We will tell you whether it fits your situation.

covers.title: Innocent spouse relief
covers.text: You are not responsible for the misdeeds of your spouse, if you know what steps to take.

covers.title: Unfiled returns
covers.text: The IRS would love to take care of your unfiled tax returns for you. We complete them properly instead.

covers.title: Your IRS file
covers.text: We cut through the red tape to get your IRS file, so you know exactly what they have on you.

covers.title: Payroll tax protection
covers.text: Failure to pay or a late payroll tax return carries penalties more severe than almost any other, and the IRS will seize assets and sell property to collect. If you are behind, we assess where you stand and find the answer that best preserves your ability to stay in business.

covers.title: Bankruptcy options
covers.text: Before you file to wipe out tax debt, interest and penalties, have the situation reviewed. Each type of bankruptcy has a different purpose, outcome and long-term effect, and if you do not qualify to eliminate tax debt that way you can be left with the liability anyway. Contact us for pre-bankruptcy counseling.

services.title: Tax Extensions
services.summary: Filed an extension? You still have time.
services.text: If you filed a request on Form 4868 by the tax deadline, you have six months to file the return. We get the filing in order, check it for accuracy and deal with any penalties arising from an extended return.
services.lead: Sometimes, no matter how hard you try, you cannot get everything done by the tax deadline. You can always ask for more time to file, but do not wait until the extension deadline to get them in.

covers.title: An extension to file is not an extension to pay
covers.text: If you are due a refund you can be on your way, but if you owe, the tax is due on the normal deadline. Otherwise you can be charged penalties, to the tune of 5% to 25%, plus interest on those penalties.

covers.title: What an extension does not do
covers.text: It does not flag you for audit, it does not affect a refund you legitimately have coming, and it does not give you more time to fund an individual retirement account unless it is the self-employed kind. They are also not hard to get.

covers.title: Special situations
covers.text: Extra time to file, and sometimes to pay, for taxpayers serving in or near combat zones, US citizens and resident aliens living abroad for business or military purposes, and those living in or providing relief to federal disaster areas.

services.title: Accounting
services.summary: Monthly or quarterly books, done for you.
services.text: Monthly or quarterly, depending on the size of your business and your needs, we take care of bank reconciliation, income statements, general ledger management and balance sheets.
services.lead: Don't waste your valuable time on bookkeeping and finances. Give yourself time to do what you do best and go out and get more clients.

covers.title: Bank reconciliation
covers.text: Identify lost checks, lost deposits or unauthorized wire transfers, detect and prevent embezzlement from within the business, and protect yourself from bank errors and fraudulent checks.

covers.title: Income statements
covers.text: Regular profit and loss statements that track operating costs, show which areas are over or under budget, and determine your current tax liability.

covers.title: General ledger management
covers.text: We can set up a general ledger system, or identify problems with your current one, so you can eliminate discrepancies and keep accurate records.

covers.title: Balance sheets
covers.text: A snapshot of the financial health of your business at any point in time, and the single most important element, with income statements, for reporting to potential lenders and investors.

covers.title: Customized add-ons
covers.text: Unlimited consultations, payroll management, tax planning and preparation, and other financial services that would benefit your business.

services.title: Bookkeeping
services.summary: Reconciled books and reports you can act on.
services.text: We reconcile discrepancies, produce and pay invoices for bills and orders, complete payroll, track transactions and generate regular reports to help you make growth decisions.
services.lead: We read between the lines of the systems, the software and the financial statements to see the true financial story being told. The future of your business doesn't have to be a question mark.

covers.title: Receivable and payable
covers.text: Accounts receivable, accounts payable and expense reimbursement kept current.

covers.title: Reconciliation and close
covers.text: Bank and credit card reconciliation, month-end close, and financial account reconciliation.

covers.title: Filings and reporting
covers.text: Sales tax, 1099 preparation and financial reporting.

covers.title: Systems and inventory
covers.text: Accounting software management and inventory control.

covers.title: Budgets and trends
covers.text: We build budgets and identify trends within your business, so you spot financial problems before they become a catastrophe.

questions.q: What is the difference between a profit and loss statement and a cash flow statement?
questions.a: A profit and loss statement shows your performance over a quarter or a year and answers whether the business made a profit. A cash flow statement tracks the actual movement of cash in and out over the same period and answers whether you have enough cash to pay your bills. Having both prepared accurately and reviewed regularly is a cornerstone of sound accounting.

services.title: Payroll Services
services.summary: Three levels, from full service to online.
services.text: The IRS is serious about payroll tax laws and the penalties for those who don't comply are stiff. We keep up with the changing federal and state tax laws so that you don't have to.
services.lead: If you process your own payroll, or pay an employee to do it, you are probably spending a minimum of 12 days a year that could go to generating new business. We offer three different levels of payroll service.

covers.title: Comprehensive payroll
covers.text: Full-service payroll: on-time check preparation and laser printing on blank maximum security check stock, free direct deposits, IRS and state tax reporting with EFTPS deposits, monthly, quarterly and annual payroll tax reports including W2, W3 and 1099 forms, sick, vacation and personal day accruals, and new hire tax paperwork.

covers.title: Post-payroll services
covers.text: If you prefer to process checks yourself, we take your data records into our files for maintenance and reporting, handle the tax reporting and deposits, and produce the same reports and new hire paperwork.

covers.title: Online payroll processing
covers.text: Enter employee hours and earnings online, print your own checks on your own computer, with free direct deposits and the same tax reporting behind it.

covers.title: Other payroll work
covers.text: Workers' compensation audits, unemployment claims, Social Security audits, child support audits, W-2 and W-3 processing, 1099 and 1096 processing, and assistance with federal and state registration.

questions.q: How do I know if someone is an employee or an independent contractor?
questions.a: Generally, if you control when, where and how the work gets done, that person is an employee. If the worker decides how the job is completed, uses their own tools and is hired for a specific project, they are more likely an independent contractor. Misclassifying someone can lead to penalties for unpaid payroll taxes.

services.title: Part-time CFO Services
services.summary: A CFO's advice without the full-time salary.
services.text: At some point your business would benefit from the advice of a full-time CFO before you are ready for the near $100,000 price tag plus bonuses and benefits. Our part-time CFO services are the bridge.
services.lead: You get all the benefits of a full-time CFO at a part-time price, available on membership retainer plans.

covers.title: An expert on the team
covers.text: The ease of knowing an expert is overseeing and protecting the financial side of your business.

covers.title: Time back
covers.text: More time to focus on growth: developing new services, attracting new customers and dealing with other core business issues.

covers.title: Understanding your numbers
covers.text: An enhanced understanding of the financial side of your business, so you can manage the hard and true numbers to the best benefit of the business.

covers.title: Tough decisions
covers.text: An expert to help guide you through tough business decisions and clarify your business plan.

services.title: Cash Flow Management
services.summary: Know when, where and how cash moves.
services.text: Understanding when, where and how your cash needs are being met is crucial to owning a successful business. Our cash flow management services help you conquer cash worry once and for all.
services.lead: In this economy cash is king, and we will make sure you are positioned right.

covers.title: Cash flow projections
covers.text: We show you how to manage daily cash through short-term weekly and monthly projections, and how to develop the capital for long-term annual and three to five year needs.

covers.title: Historical projections
covers.text: Historical cash flow projections, so you can see exactly where your cash has gone and where it could be better used.

covers.title: Banks and creditors
covers.text: How to build good relationships with banks and creditors, so resources are available when a cash crunch comes.

questions.q: How can I improve my business's cash flow?
questions.a: Get money in faster and let it out slower. Invoice immediately on delivery and follow up aggressively on overdue accounts. Negotiate longer payment terms with suppliers while keeping the relationship good. If you carry inventory, keep it lean, and build a simple 90-day forecast to anticipate tight spots before they hit.

services.title: QuickBooks Services
services.summary: Setup, training and getting your file straight.
services.text: QuickBooks handles your receipts and payables with the same ease whether your income is a little or a lot, and it grows as your business grows. We set it up, train your staff and keep it right.
services.lead: Let us set up QuickBooks for you and avoid days, or potential weeks, of hassle and aggravation.

covers.title: Hassle-free setup
covers.text: We review your current accounting system and determine your needs, set the best start date and load balances as of that date including outstanding receivables and payables, and enter transactions from the start date forward.

covers.title: Your items and sales tax
covers.text: We prepare the list of services, inventory items, non-inventory items, additional charges and sales tax that you will bill to your customers.

covers.title: Training for you and your staff
covers.text: We train you or a member of your staff to use QuickBooks for your accounting and financial management, with follow-up training to make sure it is working seamlessly.

covers.title: Periodic review
covers.text: Monthly, quarterly or annual review of the data, so you are on track for tax preparation and have the management reports you need.

services.title: Xero Services
services.summary: Cloud bookkeeping set up and supported.
services.text: Xero's cloud-based tools, combined with our expertise, make bookkeeping, invoicing and reporting simple and tailored to your business.
services.lead: Managing your finances doesn't have to be overwhelming. We handle the details so you can focus on growing your business.

covers.title: Hassle-free setup
covers.text: We review your current bookkeeping system, set up your Xero account around your needs, enter your starting balances and transactions since, and train your team to use it from day one.

covers.title: Ongoing support
covers.text: Already on Xero? We review your financial data for accuracy and consistency, clean up your records for tax season or general management, customize reports and troubleshoot your setup.

covers.title: Automation and reporting
covers.text: Automated invoicing and bank reconciliation, and customizable reports that make sense without manual spreadsheets.

covers.title: Getting paid faster
covers.text: We set up online invoicing and payment options to eliminate payment delays, and connect Xero to the software you already use.

services.title: Starting a Business
services.summary: Entity choice, a plan and your startup capital.
services.text: In order to assure your business succeeds beyond the initial thrill, you need a comprehensive plan and the right information in place before you begin. We can help you avoid becoming another failed business statistic.
services.lead: Know the simple steps for starting your business right. With our help you will identify and avoid the common mistakes many new business owners make.

covers.title: A plan and your capital needs
covers.text: Prepare a business plan and determine your initial capital needs, then identify your current resources, your sources of start-up capital and your borrowing capacity.

covers.title: Business structure
covers.text: Review potential business structures in terms of tax advantages and portability, in case you need to relocate.

covers.title: Financial management
covers.text: Plan for the financial management of your business by selecting accounting software that fits your projected budget, and the hardware to run it.

covers.title: Cash flow projection
covers.text: Understand the key components of a cash flow projection and develop one for your first period of trading.

questions.q: Should I be an LLC or an S corp for taxes?
questions.a: It comes down to how much profit the business makes and whether you want to save on self-employment taxes. With an LLC you file a Schedule C, pay self-employment tax on all profits and need no payroll, which suits newer businesses and smaller margins. With an S corp you must pay yourself a reasonable salary through payroll, but the remaining profits are not subject to self-employment tax. Most owners see the benefit when profits consistently hit $60-$80K or more a year.

services.title: Succession Planning
services.summary: Transfer the business without losing it.
services.text: Seven out of ten family owned businesses do not survive the transfer from one generation to the next. If you want the business you built to support future generations, your plans for succession have to be clarified, finalized and legalized.
services.lead: Passing your business to a family member or associate can be a risky proposition. Lack of planning, and discomfort discussing aging, death and financial affairs, more often than not ends in the loss of a business.

covers.title: What happens to the business
covers.text: Keep it in the family, sell it to a third party, or pass it on another way. We help you weigh the advantages and disadvantages of each, and work out how the business can best provide for you in retirement.

covers.title: The tax burden on transfer
covers.text: When a business transfers ownership, taxes are a reality regardless of the relationship between the parties. We review your options so you can make the decisions that minimize it.

services.title: Non-Profit Startup
services.text: To set up and keep tax exempt status, your organization has to meet very specific expense and income classifications. The way you set up your bookkeeping is crucial to maintaining non-profit status.
services.lead: Let us help you create the non-profit of your dreams. We build the bookkeeping systems the IRS expects and can file the forms for you each year.

covers.title: What the IRS looks at
covers.text: Yearly income statements categorizing donations, salaries, postage and rent; a yearly balance sheet with cash, receivables and payables; individual program expense statements detailing every expense for each program, service or seminar; and revenue support schedules for charitable donations, membership fees and investment interest.

covers.title: Getting set up
covers.text: Filing your non-profit status application, initial start-up documentation, incorporation, FEIN and payroll setup with federal and state agencies. Contact us for the list of items needed to apply for 501(c)(3) status.

services.title: Internal Control Systems
services.summary: An objective review of how money moves.
services.text: We provide an objective review of your internal control systems and determine the efficiency and effectiveness of your operating procedures.
services.lead: Discover how our systems can free you to work on your business, not in your business.

covers.title: Segregation of duties
covers.text: Segregate duties to reduce the risk of error or inappropriate action, so no one person has control over all aspects of any single financial transaction.

covers.title: Authority and review
covers.text: Ensure all transactions are handled by a delegate with approved authority, and put a process in place where every transaction is reviewed and reconciled by someone other than the transactor.

covers.title: Physical safeguards
covers.text: Assure the physical safety of equipment and introduce periodic counts, so equipment, inventory, cash and other property match the record.

covers.title: Training and documentation
covers.text: Job training for all employees, appropriate supervision, clear channels for reporting potential problems, and documentation of all policies and procedures accessible to your staff.

services.title: Strategic Business Coaching
services.summary: Build the plan the business runs on.
services.text: A strategic business plan gives your company clarity of direction, a unified vision, and keeps key members and employees focused on the tasks at hand. We help you develop it.
services.lead: More than just a tax return service: without a blueprint it is very difficult to know what you are building.

covers.title: The core components
covers.text: How the company is defined, what your products are, who your competitors are, how the company will be managed, and the processes for ensuring financial health and approaching business risk.

covers.title: When it helps most
covers.text: Starting a new business or enterprise, expanding a current one or adding a new product or service, buying a business, product or service, or turning around a failing business.

about.title: A local full-service CPA firm, founded in 2014.

faqs.q: What can I write off for my business?
faqs.a: Any ordinary and necessary business expense, but you will be asked to provide proof, so keep detailed records and receipts. Home office expenses, business meals, professional development, equipment, software subscriptions and travel costs are all legitimate deductions when they directly support your revenue-generating activities. The critical test is whether you would have incurred the expense without your business.

faqs.q: Can I write off my home office?
faqs.a: Yes, if you use part of your home exclusively and regularly for business, and that area is your principal place of business or is used to meet clients. Using your kitchen table as an office does not qualify. If you are unsure whether yours qualifies, we can help.

faqs.q: What tax credits can my small business get?
faqs.a: The most accessible are the Small Business Health Care Tax Credit for businesses with fewer than 25 employees, the Work Opportunity Tax Credit for hiring from targeted groups, and various energy efficiency credits for qualifying equipment. Many owners also overlook the Research and Development Credit, which applies more broadly than you would think, and the Disabled Access Credit provides up to $5,000 annually for accessibility improvements.

faqs.q: How do I pay less taxes as a small business owner?
faqs.a: Smart planning, and taking advantage of every opportunity the IRS provides. Be meticulous about deducting all your normal and necessary expenses, explore the credits that directly reduce your bill, and contribute to a retirement plan like a SEP IRA or Solo 401(k), which saves for your future and lowers your taxable income right away.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Contact us to schedule an appointment, at either office. The first conversation is a free consultation: let's talk about where you are now and where you want to be.
